core_idea: Lobotomy E.G.O::Solemn Lament Yi Sang is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Sinking** clash-support.
playstyle_guide:
- Skills grant **Haste** — chain them when you need higher Speed next turn.
- Plan which skills to Discard before the payoff turn.
- Build The Living & The Departed Count — spend via S1, S2 once you hit 10+.

**S1 — Celebration for the Departed** (BP 4, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 4, high 12 (High).
- Peak output requires both conditions: At 10+ The Living & The Departed, Clash Power +1 | If the sum of the target's Sinking and both Butterfly is 6 or higher, Coin Power +1.

**S2 — Solemn Lament for the Living** (BP 4, CP +6, x2): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: At 10+ The Living & The Departed, Clash Power +1 | Coin Power +1 for every 6 value of the sum of the target's Sinking and both Butterfly (max 2).

**S3 — Goodbye Now, a Sorrow in You** (BP 4, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low).
- Scales Base Power with value stacks — apply liberally before committing (cap +4).
- Spend all of The Living & The Departed on self; [On Hit] Inflict Butterfly equal to The Living & The Departed spent; [On Hit] Deal +2% damage for every value of The Living & The Departed spent by this Skill

Combat passive — **ISeeTheDyingButterfly.**: Begin encounters with 10 of each of The Living & The Departed.
  - When spending The Living & The Departed, select randomly between The Living(Potency) and The Departed(Count) for each The Living & The De….
  - When inflicting Butterfly, inflict the same amount of The Living and The Departed as they were consumed. Example below:.

Combat passive — **Hand of Salvation**: When an ally hits with a Skill, consume 2 Sinking on the target to inflict them with 1 Butterfly (3 times per turn).

Defense skill — **Counter: FromTheCoffinAButterflyTakesFlight**: [Combat Start] Reload (Solemn Lament) (once per turn).
  - [Combat Start] Gain Shield equal to (the sum of both Butterfly on the selected target)% HP (max 20% per turn).
